newsitem.title: UK: MEPC to move London hq, streamline costs.
newsitem.headline: MEPC to move London hq, streamline costs.

text.p: British real estate company MEPC Plc said on Wednesday it was to move its headquarters and make a number of changes to its internal organisation to streamline costs.
"A number of key initiatives were announced to staff today which are aimed at increasing efficiency, bringing greater focus and enhancing shareholder value," the company said in a statement.

As well as outsourcing its non-core facilities management functions, and a range of other staff tasks, MEPC said in a statement it would also move its headquarters from St. James's Square, in central London, early in 1998. This would allow it to accommodate the newly shaped team and in the process reduce its occupational costs.
